capability_name: NSW DCJ Unified Person Data Model & Hybrid Match
subtitle: Cross-Program Entity Resolution (dcj_sdm → dcj_match → dcj_tdm), Gemini 3.5 Adjudicator & Property Graph

root.label: NSW DCJ Unified Person Data Model & Hybrid Match
root.description: Unifies Child Protection, Family Preservation, and Youth Justice records into a 9-table Target Data Model and Property Graph.

details.purpose: End-to-end Child, Family, and Youth identity resolution, golden record survivorship, and graph analytics capability for the NSW Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ). Separates raw source systems (all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm) and entity resolution working tables (all-things-cdp.dcj_match) from the pure 9-table Target Data Model and Property Graph (all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm), achieving 100.00% Precision, 100.00% Recall, and 1.0000 F1 across 1,150 source records (600/600 true individuals).
details.owner: NSW DCJ Chief Data Office & Child, Family and Youth Data Architecture
details.sla: 99.9% Availability · Sub-Second Intake TVF & Daily Batch ELT
details.platform_service: BigQuery (Vector Search & Property Graph), Gemini Platform (Gemini 3.5) & BigQuery Knowledge Catalog
inputs: 1,150 source person, address, identifier, and relationship records across Child Protection (ChildStory), Family Preservation (InfoShare), and Youth Justice (KIMS) in all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm
NSW GNAF geocoded spatial address spine (260 locations) and 78 raw source relationship types
Frontline caseworker real-time intake queries and Data Steward grey-zone review decisions
outputs: Pure 9-table mastered Target Data Model in all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm (party, person, person_name, person_identity_instrument, address_location, address_relation, person_source_linkage, party_relationship, person_protection_event)
Target BigQuery Property Graph (all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm.dcj_person_graph) with 8 Node Labels and 9 Edge Labels
Entity Resolution working dataset (all-things-cdp.dcj_match) with immutable AI adjudication ledger (person_match_adjudications) and callable intake TVF (fn_person_match)
BigQuery Knowledge Catalog Business Glossary (dcj_person_cdm_glossary) with 6 categories, 118 governed terms & KPIs, and 118 Schema.<Column> EntryLinks
business_rules: Dataset Hygiene Rule: all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm contains strictly the 9 Target Data Model tables and dcj_person_graph; all 28 entity resolution working tables, 4 views, 5 UDFs, sp_connected_components, and fn_person_match reside in all-things-cdp.dcj_match.
Zero Hairball Guarantee: Shared institutional addresses and crisis refuges with degree > 5 (is_hub = TRUE) are suppressed as candidate-generation bridges.

Twin Sibling Protection: Candidate pairs sharing an SLK-581 key and DOB/address but having distinct given names and a co-resident sibling signal are blocked from auto-merging and routed to Gemini 3.5.

Cultural & Multi-Name Preservation: Every legal, preferred, alias, foster, and Aboriginal/Torres Strait Islander cultural/skin name is retained in dcj_tdm.person_name (1,623 rows) while primary_name_flag = TRUE marks the survived primary name.

children.label: Stage 1: Multi-Agency SDM Ingestion & Standardization
children.description: Ingests ChildStory, InfoShare, and KIMS source records, standardizes keys, and builds the Bipartite Identifier Graph.

details.purpose: Leftmost upstream pillar (Stages 00–20) that ingests the 14 Source Data Model (SDM) tables and views in all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm, normalizes names, phones, NSW GNAF addresses, and AIHW SLK-581 statistical linkage keys into all-things-cdp.dcj_match.stg_source_profiles, and constructs the Bipartite Identifier Graph with Inverse Document Frequency (IDF) rarity weights and Crisis Refuge Hub suppression.
details.owner: DCJ Data Integration & Source System Engineering
inputs: Child Protection (ChildStory) person, address, protection order, and relationship tables in dcj_sdm
Family Preservation (InfoShare) client, household group, address, and relationship tables in dcj_sdm
Youth Justice (KIMS) young person, alias, CNI identifier, custody/address, and relationship tables in dcj_sdm
outputs: 1,150 unified staged profiles in dcj_match.stg_source_profiles with serialized match_key dossiers
Bipartite Identifier Graph tables dcj_match.has_identifier (5,143 links) and dcj_match.identifier (2,754 distinct identifier nodes)
business_rules: Every source record retains its immutable source_rec_uid (<PROGRAM>:<SOURCE_RECORD_ID>) for end-to-end lineage.
Addresses appearing on more than 5 distinct source profiles (df > 5) are flagged is_hub = TRUE so crisis refuges and residential care homes cannot transitively link unrelated families.

children.label: Multi-Agency SDM Ingestion & Schema Contract
children.description: Ingests raw person, household, address, and relationship feeds from ChildStory, InfoShare, and KIMS into dcj_sdm.

details.purpose: Establishes the 14 Source Data Model (SDM) tables, views, and materialized views in all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm across Child Protection, Family Preservation, and Youth Justice.
inputs: ChildStory (Child Protection), InfoShare (Family Preservation), and KIMS (Youth Justice) extracts
outputs: 14 populated SDM tables, views, and materialized views in all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm
business_rules: Preserves raw source-specific schemas, 16 name usage codes, and all 78 raw relationship strings without destructive pre-filtering.

children.label: ChildStory & KIMS Person-Address-Relationship Feed
children.description: Captures Child Protection and Youth Justice person profiles, aliases, CNI/NDIS IDs, addresses, and kinship links.

details.purpose: Loads ChildStory (cp_person, cp_address, cp_relationship, cp_protection_order) and Youth Justice KIMS (yj_person, yj_alias, yj_address, yj_relationship) records into all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm.
details.owner: Child Protection & Youth Justice Data Engineering
inputs: ChildStory case management extracts (CS-10001..)
Youth Justice KIMS custodial and community supervision records (YJ-30001..)
outputs: Populated cp_* and yj_* source tables and standardized views in dcj_sdm
business_rules: Captures both Verified and Estimated dates of birth and preserves Youth Justice preferred/street aliases alongside legal names.

children.label: InfoShare Household Group & Client Intake Feed
children.description: Ingests Family Preservation client profiles, household group memberships (GRP-*), and service provider referrals.

details.purpose: Loads InfoShare Family Preservation records (fp_client, fp_household_group, fp_address, fp_relationship) into all-things-cdp.dcj_sdm, including multi-person family group entities.
inputs: InfoShare Family Preservation client and household group extracts (FP-CL-50001.., GRP-8001..)
outputs: Populated fp_* source tables and materialized views in dcj_sdm
business_rules: Links individual Family Preservation clients to their parent Household Group (GRP-*) via Group Member relationships.

children.label: Name, Phone, GNAF & SLK-581 Normalization Engine
children.description: Normalizes diacritics, phonetic tokens, mobile numbers, GNAF PIDs, and AIHW SLK-581 linkage keys via SQL UDFs.

details.purpose: Applies deterministic BigQuery SQL UDFs in dcj_match and dcj_sdm to standardize noisy demographic attributes prior to blocking and vector embedding.
inputs: Raw person names, birth dates, gender codes, phone numbers, and street strings from dcj_sdm
outputs: Normalized given/family names, SOUNDEX codes, E.164/Australian 10-digit phones, GNAF PIDs, and 14-char SLK-581 keys
business_rules: SLK-581 follows AIHW standard: letters 2, 3, 5 of family name + letters 2, 3 of given name + DDMMYYYY birth date + sex code (padded with '2' for short names or '9' for missing letters).

children.label: Diacritic, Phonetic & AIHW SLK-581 Key Generator
children.description: Executes fold_diacritics, SOUNDEX, norm_phone, and compute_slk581 UDFs across all 1,150 source records.

details.purpose: Provides reusable BigQuery UDFs (dcj_match.fold_diacritics, dcj_match.norm_phone, dcj_match.compute_slk581) to generate deterministic blocking tokens.
inputs: Raw given_name, middle_name, family_name, date_of_birth, gender, and phone strings
outputs: Clean uppercase ASCII name tokens, SOUNDEX phonetic keys, normalized 10-digit phones, and SLK-581 keys
business_rules: Strips non-digit characters and normalizes +61 prefixes to 04xx local format via dcj_match.norm_phone.

children.label: NSW GNAF Address & Relationship Harmoniser
children.description: Standardizes street suffixes, binds GNAF PIDs with lat/lon coordinates, and maps 78 relationship types into 5 categories.

details.purpose: Standardizes NSW street addresses via dcj_sdm.standardize_address and maps all 78 raw SDM relationship strings into canonical types and 5 high-level categories via dcj_match.canonical_relationship_type and dcj_match.relationship_category.
inputs: Raw street address strings, suburbs, postcodes, GNAF PIDs, and 78 raw relationship strings
outputs: Standardized GNAF address records and harmonised relationship categories (IMMEDIATE_FAMILY, EXTENDED_OR_KINSHIP_FAMILY, CARE_AND_GUARDIANSHIP, HOUSEHOLD_OR_DOMESTIC, SERVICE_OR_GROUP)
business_rules: Preserves culturally significant kinship terms (Aunty/Uncle, Nanna/Pop, Cousin-Sibling, Kinship Carer) under EXTENDED_OR_KINSHIP_FAMILY.

children.label: Staged Source Profile Store (stg_source_profiles)
children.description: Maintains the 1,150 unified source profiles and serialized natural-language match_key dossiers in dcj_match.

details.purpose: Central staging persistence module (sql/10_stage_sources.sql) that consolidates all 1,150 ChildStory, InfoShare, and KIMS profiles into all-things-cdp.dcj_match.stg_source_profiles and builds the serialized match_key text dossier for embedding.
details.sla: 1,150 Staged Profiles · Zero Orphan Source Records

crud_entities.notes: Reads raw ChildStory, InfoShare, and KIMS person, name, address, and relationship records
1,150 normalized source profiles with SLK-581, SOUNDEX, kinship context, and match_key dossier
Projected profile summary for fast pair dossier assembly

inputs: Normalized person, alias, identifier, address, and relationship records from DCJ-01-01 and DCJ-01-02
outputs: Populated dcj_match.stg_source_profiles (1,150 rows) with rich match_key text strings
business_rules: Each match_key concatenates normalized name, aliases, DOB, sex, SLK-581, GNAF suburb/postcode, and known family/household relationships into a deterministic text profile.

children.label: Bipartite Identifier Graph & Crisis Refuge Hub Guard
children.description: Constructs the Bipartite Identifier Graph (has_identifier, identifier) with IDF rarity weights and hub suppression.

details.purpose: Executes sql/20_bipartite_graph.sql to project every shared signal (CNI, NDIS, ChildStory ID, Phone, GNAF PID, SLK-581, Name+DOB) into a bipartite graph between SourceRecords and Identifier nodes, weighting rare identifiers higher and quarantining high-degree institutional hubs.
inputs: 1,150 staged profiles in dcj_match.stg_source_profiles
outputs: dcj_match.has_identifier (5,143 edges) and dcj_match.identifier (2,754 nodes with idf_weight and is_hub)
business_rules: IDF weight is computed as LN(1 + N / df) where N = 1,150 and df is the number of distinct source profiles sharing the identifier.
Any ADDRESS_GNAF or PHONE node with df > 5 is marked is_hub = TRUE and excluded from generating candidate match edges.

children.label: Bipartite Identifier & IDF Rarity Calculator
children.description: Extracts 5,143 profile-to-identifier edges and calculates LN(1 + N/df) rarity weights across 2,754 identifiers.

details.purpose: Populates dcj_match.has_identifier and computes document frequency (df) and Inverse Document Frequency (idf_weight) in dcj_match.identifier.
inputs: Staged identifiers (CNI, NDIS, CHILDSTORY_ID, SLK_581, PHONE, ADDRESS_GNAF, EXACT_NAME_DOB) from stg_source_profiles
outputs: Weighted identifier nodes in dcj_match.identifier and profile-identifier edges in dcj_match.has_identifier
business_rules: Unique government identifiers (CNI, NDIS) receive high prior reliability multiplied by their IDF rarity score.

children.label: Crisis Refuge & Group Home Hub Suppressor (df > 5)
children.description: Flags shared crisis refuges and residential care homes (df > 5) with is_hub = TRUE to prevent hairball clusters.

details.purpose: Detects high-degree institutional addresses (such as Parramatta Women's Crisis Refuge shared by 75 records) and shared agency landlines, setting is_hub = TRUE in dcj_match.identifier and dcj_match.block_stats.
inputs: Identifier degree counts (df) across ADDRESS_GNAF, PHONE, and SUBURB_POSTCODE nodes
outputs: is_hub = TRUE flags on institutional hub nodes in dcj_match.identifier
business_rules: Eliminates the 75-person crisis refuge hairball cluster seen in naive connected components while preserving the refuge address in dcj_tdm.address_relation for residency history.

children.label: Stage 2: Hybrid Retrieval, RRF Scoring & Gemini 3.5 Adjudication
children.description: Combines BigQuery Vector Search, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and the Gemini Platform AI Adjudicator (Gemini 3.5).

details.purpose: Core hybrid entity resolution pillar (Stages 30–50) in all-things-cdp.dcj_match. Embeds every profile dossier using autonomous AI.EMBED (text-embedding-005), retrieves semantic candidates via native BigQuery Vector Search (VECTOR_SEARCH), fuses lexical and semantic rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60) with 2-Hop Kinship Context and Twin SLK-581 Collision Guard, and adjudicates all 391 borderline GREY_ZONE pairs via AI.GENERATE on Gemini 3.5 (Gemini Platform).
details.platform_service: BigQuery Vector Search & Gemini Platform AI Adjudicator (gemini-3.5-flash)
inputs: dcj_match.stg_source_profiles (1,150 profiles) and dcj_match.has_identifier / dcj_match.identifier
outputs: dcj_match.source_profile_search and dcj_match.source_profile_vectors (768-d embeddings)
dcj_match.candidate_pair_tiers (405 AUTO_MATCH, 391 GREY_ZONE, 13,690 REJECT)
dcj_match.person_match_adjudications (391 structured Gemini 3.5 verdicts + rationale) and dcj_match.person_match_decisions
business_rules: Tiered Routing: Composite hybrid scores >= 0.85 with no twin/DOB conflict route to AUTO_MATCH; scores in [0.45, 0.85) or flagged with twin/conflict signals route to GREY_ZONE for Gemini 3.5 adjudication; scores < 0.45 route to REJECT.

Every Gemini 3.5 adjudication is recorded in the append-only dcj_match.person_match_adjudications ledger with structured match_decision, confidence, evidence_signals, conflict_signals, and clinical/caseworker rationale.

children.label: Autonomous Profile Embedding & BigQuery Vector Search
children.description: Generates autonomous AI.EMBED vector embeddings (text-embedding-005) and executes native BigQuery VECTOR_SEARCH.

details.purpose: Executes sql/30_embed_and_search.sql to maintain autonomous 768-dimensional embeddings on match_key dossiers and retrieve top-K semantically similar profiles across programs even when names change (e.g., adoptive/foster name changes, cultural skin names, or nicknames like Lachie ↔ Lachlan).
details.sla: 1,150 Embedded Dossiers · Top-15 Semantic Retrieval per Profile
inputs: Serialized match_key dossiers in dcj_match.stg_source_profiles
outputs: dcj_match.source_profile_search, dcj_match.source_profile_vectors, and dcj_match.candidate_pairs_semantic
business_rules: Uses BigQuery GENERATED ALWAYS AS (AI.EMBED(content => match_key, endpoint => 'text-embedding-005')) so embeddings stay automatically synchronized with source table updates.

children.label: Autonomous Dossier Embedding Generator (AI.EMBED)
children.description: Maintains 768-dimensional text-embedding-005 vectors on dcj_match.source_profile_search via GENERATED ALWAYS columns.

details.purpose: Creates dcj_match.source_profile_search with autonomous AI.EMBED generation and materializes dcj_match.source_profile_vectors for high-throughput cosine similarity search.
inputs: match_key text dossiers from dcj_match.stg_source_profiles
outputs: 768-d FLOAT64 embedding vectors in dcj_match.source_profile_search and dcj_match.source_profile_vectors
business_rules: Embeds demographic, alias, address, and kinship tokens together so cross-program records with different legal names but shared family/suburb context cluster in vector space.

children.label: Top-K Semantic Candidate Retriever (VECTOR_SEARCH)
children.description: Retrieves top-15 nearest neighbor profiles per record using native BigQuery VECTOR_SEARCH cosine similarity.

details.purpose: Executes BigQuery VECTOR_SEARCH over dcj_match.source_profile_vectors to surface non-obvious candidate pairs (such as Adoptive/Foster Name Changes and ATSI Cultural/Skin Names) that share zero exact name tokens.
details.sla: 100% Recall on Adoptive, Foster & Cultural Alias Scenarios
inputs: dcj_match.source_profile_vectors (1,150 768-d vectors)
outputs: Ranked semantic candidate pairs with cosine similarity scores in dcj_match.candidate_pairs_semantic
business_rules: Canonicalizes pairs as (rec_a < rec_b) and computes semantic_rank per anchor profile for downstream Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

children.label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), Kinship & Twin Guard
children.description: Fuses lexical IDF and vector rankings via RRF (k=60), adds 2-hop kinship boosts, and flags twin SLK-581 collisions.

details.purpose: Executes sql/40_hybrid_candidates_rrf.sql to combine deterministic bipartite IDF evidence with semantic vector rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, enrich pairs with shared 2-hop kinship/household evidence, detect twin sibling collisions, and assign each pair to AUTO_MATCH, GREY_ZONE, or REJECT.
details.sla: 14,486 Evaluated Candidate Pairs → 405 AUTO_MATCH, 391 GREY_ZONE, 13,690 REJECT
inputs: dcj_match.candidate_pairs_lexical, dcj_match.candidate_pairs_semantic, and dcj_sdm relationship tables
outputs: dcj_match.candidate_pairs_fused and dcj_match.candidate_pair_tiers
business_rules: RRF score is computed as 1 / (60 + lexical_rank) + 1 / (60 + semantic_rank).
Pairs sharing an SLK-581 + DOB + address where given names differ (Jaro-Winkler / edit distance) are flagged is_potential_twin = TRUE and forced into GREY_ZONE.

children.label: Lexical + Semantic RRF Scorer (k = 60)
children.description: Combines non-hub bipartite IDF weights and BigQuery Vector Search ranks using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

details.purpose: Merges dcj_match.candidate_pairs_lexical and dcj_match.candidate_pairs_semantic into dcj_match.candidate_pairs_fused with unified RRF and hybrid match scores.
inputs: Lexical IDF scores/ranks from dcj_match.candidate_pairs_lexical and cosine similarity/ranks from dcj_match.candidate_pairs_semantic
outputs: Unified rrf_score, lexical_strength, and semantic_similarity in dcj_match.candidate_pairs_fused
business_rules: Tags each candidate pair with retrieval provenance (LEXICAL_ONLY, SEMANTIC_ONLY, or BOTH).

children.label: 2-Hop Kinship Boost & Twin SLK-581 Collision Guard
children.description: Boosts pairs sharing a parent/carer or household group and diverts same-DOB twin SLK-581 collisions to GREY_ZONE.

details.purpose: Computes 2-hop kinship overlap (shared mother, grandmother, kinship carer, or InfoShare household group) and applies the Twin Sibling Collision Guard before tiering into dcj_match.candidate_pair_tiers.
details.sla: 0 Twin False Merges (eliminates 120 deterministic twin FPs)
inputs: dcj_match.candidate_pairs_fused and cross-program kinship/group relationships
outputs: Tiered candidate pairs in dcj_match.candidate_pair_tiers (AUTO_MATCH, GREY_ZONE, REJECT)
business_rules: Same-sex twins born on the same day with similar first-name letters (e.g., Jayden & Hayden Taylor → TAYJA120820141) share an identical SLK-581; the Twin Guard prevents automatic merge and routes them to Gemini 3.5.

children.label: Gemini Platform AI Adjudicator (gemini-3.5-flash)
children.description: Adjudicates 391 borderline GREY_ZONE pairs via AI.GENERATE on Gemini 3.5 with structured JSON verdicts and rationale.

details.purpose: Executes sql/50_genai_adjudicator.sql using BigQuery AI.GENERATE over connection all-things-cdp.us-central1.dcj-conn to Gemini 3.5 (gemini-3.5-flash on Gemini Platform). Evaluates complex social-work edge cases (ATSI cultural/skin names, foster/adoptive surname changes, DV protected relocations, estimated vs. verified DOBs, and twin collisions) and emits schema-constrained verdicts.
details.owner: DCJ Responsible AI & MDM Governance Lead
details.sla: 391 Grey-Zone Pairs Adjudicated · 100% Structured Schema Compliance
details.platform_service: Gemini Platform (gemini-3.5-flash) via BigQuery AI.GENERATE Connection (dcj-conn)

agent_config.hitl_mode: Autonomous Structured Adjudication for Confidence >= 0.70 · Data Steward Escalation Queue for Low-Confidence / Conflicting Pairs

inputs: 391 GREY_ZONE candidate pair dossiers from dcj_match.candidate_pair_tiers (including both profiles, shared identifiers, kinship overlap, and conflict flags)
outputs: Structured JSON output: match_decision (MATCH | NO_MATCH | REVIEW), confidence (0.0–1.0), evidence_signals, conflict_signals, and human-readable rationale
business_rules: Never overwrites or fabricates source attributes; strictly evaluates whether two staged source records represent the same real-world individual.
Explicitly distinguishes co-resident twin siblings (NO_MATCH) from true cross-program aliases or cultural skin names (MATCH).

children.label: Immutable AI Adjudication Audit Ledger
children.description: Records all Gemini 3.5 verdicts, confidence scores, prompt hashes, and steward overrides in person_match_adjudications.

details.purpose: Append-only governance and audit persistence module in all-things-cdp.dcj_match that stores every AI adjudication decision, model version, prompt hash, and rationale, and combines AUTO_MATCH + approved Gemini 3.5 MATCH verdicts into dcj_match.person_match_decisions.
details.sla: 100% Immutable Audit Trail ·Governed by 15 Knowledge Catalog Terms

crud_entities.notes: 14,486 scored candidate pairs tiered into AUTO_MATCH (405), GREY_ZONE (391), and REJECT (13,690)
Immutable append-only AI adjudication audit ledger (391 Gemini 3.5 decisions with rationale & prompt hash)
Unified pairwise decision table combining deterministic AUTO_MATCH and Gemini 3.5 adjudications

inputs: Structured adjudication responses from DCJ-02-03 (dcj_match.stg_adjudications_new) and deterministic tiers from DCJ-02-02
outputs: dcj_match.person_match_adjudications, dcj_match.v_adjudications_current, and dcj_match.person_match_decisions
business_rules: Incremental hashing (pair_dossier_hash) ensures unchanged candidate pairs are never re-billed to Gemini 3.5 on subsequent pipeline runs.

children.label: Data Steward Grey-Zone & Split/Merge Workbench
children.description: Provides Human-in-the-Loop review of Gemini 3.5 rationales, side-by-side source dossiers, and manual split/merge overrides.

details.purpose: Interactive stewardship view over dcj_match.v_adjudications_current and dcj_match.component_contradictions enabling DCJ Data Stewards to inspect Gemini 3.5 evidence signals, approve borderline links, or force manual splits.
details.owner: DCJ Data Stewardship & Child Safety Operations
details.sla: Same-Business-Day Steward Review for Flagged Contradictions
inputs: dcj_match.v_adjudications_current (Gemini 3.5 rationale, evidence_signals, conflict_signals) and dcj_match.component_contradictions
outputs: Audited Steward override records appended to dcj_match.person_match_adjudications
business_rules: Every manual steward override requires a documented reason code and preserves the prior Gemini 3.5 verdict in the append-only ledger.

children.label: Stage 3: Graph Clustering, Golden Survivorship & 9-Table TDM
children.description: Clusters verified pairs via Two-Pass Connected Components and populates the pure 9-table Target Data Model and Property Graph.

details.purpose: Downstream mastering and graph modeling pillar (Stages 60–70). Runs Two-Pass Connected Components (dcj_match.sp_connected_components) with Contradiction Pruning to resolve 1,150 source records into 600 golden individuals (0 false merges, 0 hairballs), applies field survivorship rules, populates the strictly isolated 9-table Target Data Model in all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm, and declares the Target Property Graph (all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm.dcj_person_graph).
details.owner: DCJ Enterprise Data Modeling & MDM Lead
details.sla: 600 Resolved Entities · 0 Hairballs · Pure 9-Table + Graph dcj_tdm Dataset
details.platform_service: BigQuery Procedural SQL & BigQuery Property Graph (ISO GQL)
inputs: Verified match edges in dcj_match.person_match_decisions and staged attributes in dcj_match.stg_source_profiles
outputs: 600 mastered person clusters in dcj_match.person_assignment
All 9 Target Data Model tables in all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm
Target Property Graph all-things-cdp.dcj_tdm.dcj_person_graph (8 Node Labels, 9 Edge Labels)
business_rules: Two-Pass Contradiction Guard: If any Pass-1 connected component contains an internal verified-DOB/ID conflict, weak edges (< 0.92) and zero-IDF cross-surname bridges (non_hub_idf_sum = 0 AND NOT surname_or_alias_match) are pruned and Pass-2 Connected Components re-clusters the component cleanly.
Golden Survivorship Priority: Verified DOB > Estimated DOB; ChildStory > Youth Justice > InfoShare for legal identity attributes; OR-rollup for is_protected_person across all linked records.

children.label: Two-Pass Connected Components & Contradiction Pruning
children.description: Executes iterative label propagation (sp_connected_components) in dcj_match with Pass-2 contradiction pruning.

details.purpose: Executes sql/60_connected_components_and_tdm.sql (Part A) in all-things-cdp.dcj_match to transitively close verified pairwise links into deterministic person_id clusters (`PER-<12_HEX>`) while guaranteeing zero over-merged hairballs.
details.sla: Converges in <= 5 Iterations · Max Cluster Size = 3 · 0 Hairballs
inputs: dcj_match.graph_nodes (1,150 nodes) and dcj_match.edges_pass1 (verified match edges)
outputs: dcj_match.cc_pass1, dcj_match.component_contradictions, dcj_match.edges_pass2, dcj_match.cc_final, and dcj_match.person_assignment
business_rules: Deterministic Golden ID: Each final component_id is hashed into a stable `'PER-' || UPPER(SUBSTR(TO_HEX(SHA256(component_id)), 1, 12))` identifier.

children.label: Pass-1 Graph Label Propagation (sp_connected_components)
children.description: Propagates minimum component_id labels across verified match edges until convergence in dcj_match.cc_pass1.

details.purpose: Reusable BigQuery procedural SQL loop (dcj_match.sp_connected_components) that computes connected components over any node and edge table in pure SQL.
inputs: dcj_match.graph_nodes and dcj_match.edges_pass1
outputs: Pass-1 component assignments in dcj_match.cc_pass1
business_rules: Also runs benchmark comparisons for Method 1 (dcj_match.cc_baseline) and Method 2 (dcj_match.cc_weighted) to prove the F1 lift in v_dcj_method_comparison.

children.label: Twin & Contradiction Edge Pruner (Pass-2 Re-Cluster)
children.description: Detects internal NO_MATCH contradictions in cc_pass1, prunes weak bridges, and re-runs Pass-2 clustering into cc_final.

details.purpose: Inspects every Pass-1 cluster for internal pairs explicitly rejected by Gemini 3.5 or the Twin Guard (dcj_match.component_contradictions), removes low-confidence bridge edges in dcj_match.edges_pass2, and produces dcj_match.cc_final and dcj_match.person_assignment.
inputs: dcj_match.cc_pass1 and explicit NO_MATCH pairs from dcj_match.person_match_decisions
outputs: Clean dcj_match.cc_final and dcj_match.person_assignment (1,150 rows → 600 golden person_id clusters)
business_rules: Any component with a verified-DOB/ID contradiction has weak edges (< 0.92) and zero-IDF cross-surname bridges (non_hub_idf_sum = 0 AND NOT surname_or_alias_match) pruned before Pass-2 re-clustering.

children.label: Golden Person Survivorship & Protection Rollup Engine
children.description: Resolves golden demographic attributes (dcj_match.field_survivorship) and rolls up Domestic Violence/Child Safety flags.

details.purpose: Evaluates competing attribute assertions across ChildStory, InfoShare, and KIMS in dcj_match.field_assertions and selects the authoritative golden value per person_id in dcj_match.field_survivorship.
inputs: dcj_match.person_assignment and dcj_match.stg_source_profiles
outputs: dcj_match.field_assertions and survived golden attributes in dcj_match.field_survivorship
business_rules: DOB Survivorship: Verified DOB beats Estimated DOB; ties broken by program authority (ChildStory = 3, Youth Justice = 2, InfoShare = 1) and latest recency.
Safety Rollup: If any linked source record has a Domestic Violence or Child Protection restriction, is_protected_person = TRUE on the golden person record.

children.label: 9-Table Target Data Model Persistence (dcj_tdm)
